battle.name: 申河之戰
battle.theater: 信德省申河下游與烏奇
battle.brief: 一二二一年春，蒙古軍追花剌子模殘部至印度河下游，渡傑赫勒姆河、克木蘭後長驅信德，在申河擊破花剌子模騎兵並攻下烏奇。季風洪水與成吉思汗死訊令遠征止於印度河西岸。卡面希臘火靠銅管與祕方維持壟斷，此役真正發揮作用的是可隨軍搬運的攻城與渡河工程。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 申河之戰是蒙古第一次西征在印度河下游的一場戰鬥，交戰雙方是蒙古帝國與花剌子模帝國的殘餘軍力。蒙古一方由大汗成吉思汗直接指揮的西征軍派出兩路先鋒，長子術赤與次子察合台分兵南下，另有別兒哥一支部眾同行；軍令仍沿用大汗的十進編制，萬戶、千戶、百戶各領其眾，傳騎、鼓號與煙火遞令，後方由大汗帳殿與隨軍工匠營供應弓矢、鎧甲、繩索與攻城器械。攻城器械多由隨軍的華人工匠與回回工匠就地打造，這是蒙古西征最為後人注意的一點：不是靠運來的成品攻城，而是靠帶得走的工匠隊。花剌子模一方則是崩潰後的殘局，蘇丹札木亦兒帶著尚能集結的騎兵退入印度河下游，據守克木蘭與烏奇兩座城，另有游騎在河谷與商道上游蕩；其指揮體系仍是波斯式的阿米爾分領，但兵源與馬匹都已耗盡，城防全靠土築城牆與守軍。第三方並非旁觀者：德里蘇丹國的蘇丹伊勒圖密什收留了札木亦兒，並在一二二二年致書蒙古要求交人，使這場河邊的戰鬥牽動到北印度的政治。卡面兵器所屬的拜占庭帝國此刻三分為尼西亞、埃普魯斯與拉丁帝國，與申河無涉，卻正好提供另一端的對照。
countriesEn: The Battle of the Sind River was an engagement of the Mongol first westward expedition on the lower Indus, fought between the Mongol Empire and the surviving armed forces of the Khwarazmian state. The Mongol side drew two advance columns out of the western expedition personally commanded by the Great Khan Genghis, his eldest son Jochi and second son Chagatai leading separate bodies southward, with a detachment under Jobe among them. Command still followed the Great Khan's decimal organisation, ten-thousand, thousand and hundred leaders each commanding their own men, orders carried by mounted messengers, drums and smoke signals, while the khan's tent and the travelling engineer corps supplied bows, arrows, armour, rope and siege matériel. The siege engines were mostly built on the spot by Chinese and Muslim craftsmen carried along with the army, and that is the point about the western expedition that later writers noticed: the Mongols did not take cities with finished machines shipped from somewhere else, they took them with a body of craftsmen who could travel. The Khwarazmian side was a ruin. Sultan Jalal al-Din had with him only the cavalry he could still rally, withdrawn into the lower Indus, holding the cities of Multan and Uch, with bands of horsemen raiding the river valleys and the trade routes beyond. Its command structure was still the Persian one, with amirs holding separate commands, but manpower and horses were spent, and the defences rested on mud-brick walls and garrisons. The third party was no spectator: the Sultan of Delhi, Iltutmish, gave refuge to Jalal al-Din and in 1222 wrote to the Mongols demanding his surrender, so a battle on a riverbank reached into the politics of northern India. The empire of the weapon on the card, Byzantium, stood at this moment divided between Nicaea, Epirus and the Latin Empire, and had nothing to do with the Sind, though it supplies the other end of the comparison.
people: 決定這場戰役走向的是幾個人。蒙古方面，長子術赤與次子察合台率前鋒越過印度河，據說為蒙古軍引路的是花剌子模的降將失吉忽屯忽，此人更為人所知的是兩年後引蒙古軍直取迦勒迦河；有了這類嚮導，蒙古軍在信德一帶的推進才沒有走錯河道。大汗成吉思汗本人仍在中亞的帳殿遙控全局，直到八月二十五日病逝於六盤山，死訊傳到印度河前線約在秋天，遠征隨即收束。札木亦兒是花剌子模最後的蘇丹，申河一役失利後退入德里，向伊勒圖密什求援，一二二六年再返波斯，一二三一年在伊拉克被殺，此後花剌子模的名號只存在於回憶裡。克木蘭與烏奇的守軍首領沒有留下名字，只留下抵抗與陷落兩段記錄。第三方方面，德里蘇丹伊勒圖密什在收留札木亦兒之後寫信給蒙古朝廷，這封信與其後抵達德里的蒙古使團，構成北印度與蒙古之間最早的一批官方接觸。卡面兵器一端也可對照：一二二一年，尼西亞帝國的軍隊在伯羅奔尼撒擊敗拉丁帝國的軍隊，但交戰雙方都沒有可用的希臘火配方與銅管，因為祕方早已在第四次十字軍攻君士坦丁堡時隨火船沉入海底。
peopleEn: A handful of men decided how this battle went. On the Mongol side, the eldest son Jochi and the second son Chagatai led the vanguard across the Indus, and the Mongols are said to have been guided through the country of Sindh by a Khwarazmian defector, Shigi Qutuq, a man better known for leading the Mongols straight to the Kalka River two years later; with guides of this kind the advance did not lose the river courses. The Great Khan Genghis himself was still directing matters from his tent in Central Asia until he fell ill and died at Liupan on the twenty-fifth of August; the news reached the Indus front in the autumn, and the expedition was wound up. Jalal al-Din was the last Sultan of Khwarazm, and after his defeat on the Sind he withdrew to Delhi and asked Iltutmish for help, returning to Persia in 1226 and being killed in Iraq in 1231, after which the name of Khwarazm survived only in memory. The commanders who held Multan and Uch left no names behind, only two entries in the record: resistance, and fall. On the third party, the Delhi Sultan Iltutmish, having taken Jalal al-Din in, wrote to the Mongol court; that letter, and the Mongol embassy that afterwards reached Delhi, form the earliest official contacts between northern India and the Mongols. The weapon on the card can be set alongside: in 1221 the army of the Empire of Nicaea defeated the forces of the Latin Empire in the Peloponnese, yet neither side had the Greek fire formula or the copper siphon to hand, because the formula had gone down with the fire ships when the Fourth Crusade attacked Constantinople.
kits: 卡面是希臘火：裝在銅管裡的燃燒劑，靠銅管虹吸把點了火的液體推出，靠人泵加壓，靠配方比例與銅管形製維持效果；配方是帝國的機密，一二〇三年第四次十字軍攻君士坦丁堡時火船焚燒拉丁艦隊，配方與船同沉，此後再無人造得出同樣的東西。這件兵器有兩個前提：銅管要固定在穩定平台上，發射要有風勢配合，射程與角度都受銅管長短限制，它是一件奇襲兵器而非野戰裝備。申河一役的現場既沒有銅管，也沒有可擱置銅管的穩定船台，那是內陸大河，水流湍急、兩岸多軟泥灘，風向不定。真正在場並且決定勝負的裝備分屬兩類。第一類是蒙古軍的攻城工程：配重投石車以長臂把石彈拋過土築城牆，隨軍工匠營在河邊就地搭造，攻城之後可以再用；還有壕溝、地道與封堵缺口的木柵。第二類是渡河器材：當地船隻、羊皮吹脹的浮囊、綁紮的木排與牛皮舟橋，蒙古軍靠這一套跨過了錫爾河、傑赫勒姆河與印度河，並把攻城器械送到對岸。交戰雙方也都帶了火：蒙古軍的硫磺火瓶與火矢，花剌子模守軍在同一年內沙布兒城頭用滾燙的猛火油澆退攻城騎兵，但那種貼身即滅的散射式燃燒擋得住一兩次衝鋒，擋不住配重石彈與被封死的渡口。
kitsEn: The card shows Greek fire: a burning liquid carried in a copper siphon, pushed out by the siphon once ignited, driven by human pumps, effective only as long as the proportions of the formula and the shape of the tube held. The formula was the empire's secret; when the Fourth Crusade attacked Constantinople the fire ships burned the Latin fleet in 1203, and the formula went down with the ships, after which nobody could make the same thing again. The weapon had two preconditions: the copper tube had to be fixed on a stable platform, and the discharge needed the wind to cooperate, while range and angle were both limited by the length of the tube. It was a weapon for surprise, not for the open field. The field at the Sind had neither copper tube nor a stable platform to mount one on: this was a broad inland river with a swift current, muddy banks and unreliable wind. The equipment actually present, and actually decisive, fell into two kinds. The first was the Mongol siege engineering: counterweight trebuchets that flung stone over mud-brick walls, built on the spot by the travelling engineer corps and reusable after a siege, together with trenches, mines and timber barricades to close breaches. The second was river-crossing equipment: local boats, hides inflated into floats, lashed timber rafts and hide pontoon bridges. It was with these that the Mongols crossed the Syr Darya, the Jhelum and the Indus, and carried their siege engines to the far bank. Both sides carried fire as well: the Mongols had sulphur jars and fire arrows, and the Khwarazmian defenders poured boiling naphtha on the assaulting horsemen from the walls of Nishapur in the same year. But that kind of scattered burning, which dies out the moment it loses contact, can hold off one or two charges, and cannot hold off counterweight stone and a sealed crossing.
tactics: 申河一役的戰術，是蒙古軍在西征中反覆使用、到一二二一年已近乎例行的一套辦法：多路分進、封住渡口、把對手壓進河谷與城堡之間。蒙古軍沒有把主力一次壓上河道，而是先以偵察騎確認河道寬窄、渡口狀況與守軍所在，再決定夜渡、繫舟為橋，還是強攻對岸堡寨；克木蘭就是這樣被封住四門、外援斷絕而陷落。到了申河，花剌子模騎兵選擇在兩岸與下游河道布防，靠縱騎衝擊與弓矢射擊拖住蒙古前鋒，打算讓追兵停在南岸，拖到季風洪水再逼其退兵。蒙古軍的回應，是把攻城與渡河能力直接當作野戰的一部分：搭橋、渡河、分割敵軍騎兵集群，再在能展開的地面上以弓矢消耗、以長矛與刀近身結陣。決定戰局的另一個條件是天時：信德地區四月至九月是酷熱與季風洪水期，河水暴漲，河面寬闊難渡，馬匹在暑熱中掉膘，蒙古軍停留越久，補給與戰馬消耗越大。卡面兵器在此可作對照：希臘火的銅管需要穩定平台與風勢，信德河既不給平台也不給風勢；同樣是燃燒劑，花剌子模守軍的猛火油與蒙古軍的火瓶卻在任何地面都能用。誰能先把渡河器材架好、誰能先把石彈送到城牆上，誰就決定了申河邊的這一天。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the Sind were a set of methods the Mongols had used again and again during the western expedition and that by 1221 had become routine: advance in several columns, seal the crossings, and press the enemy into the ground between the river valleys and the fortified towns. The Mongols did not commit their main body to the river in one move. Reconnaissance riders first established the width of the channels, the state of the fords and the whereabouts of the defenders, and only then did the column choose between a night crossing, a bridge of moored boats, or a direct assault on the fort on the far bank; Multan fell in just such a way, its four gates sealed and its relief cut off. At the Sind the Khwarazmian cavalry took position along both banks and on the lower reaches, holding the Mongol vanguard off with charge and arrow and hoping to keep the pursuers on the southern bank until the monsoon flood forced them to withdraw. The Mongol answer was to treat the ability to build and to cross as part of the open-field battle: bridge the water, cross, cut the enemy cavalry into separate groups, then in ground where the formation could open, wear them down with the bow and close with lance and sabre. The other condition deciding the day was the season: in Sindh the months from April to September bring scorching heat and the monsoon flood, the river rises, the crossing widens and becomes hard, and horses lose condition in the heat, so every day the Mongols stayed cost them provisions and remounts. The weapon on the card is a useful contrast here. The copper siphon of Greek fire needed a stable platform and the wind; the river at Sindh gave neither. The same category of weapon, the boiling naphtha of the Khwarazmian garrisons and the fire jars of the Mongols, could be used on any ground. Whoever set the crossing equipment in place first, whoever put the stone onto the wall first, decided the day on the banks of the Sind.
data: 這場戰爭留下的數字不多，可靠的更少，但輪廓尚可說明。時間上，克木蘭在一二二一年初被蒙古軍攻陷，申河一戰緊接在其後兩三個月內，多數說法置於春末夏初；本卡所取的四月只是這段區間的代表，確月無從考訂。距離上，蒙古軍自克木蘭沿印度河右岸南下至烏奇一線，行程約三四百公里，沿途要穿過多處河曲、鹹水三角洲與沼澤地帶。兵力方面，各書對深入印度河流域的蒙古軍說法不一，常見的量級是兩萬至三萬騎的數萬之眾，另配工匠、醫護與帳幕僕役；花剌子模一方能集結的兵力沒有可靠數字，只能看出殘餘騎兵加上克木蘭、烏奇的守軍，總量遠不如追兵。行程成本同樣可估：蒙古軍自克木蘭至申河推進約三至四個月，其間要徵船、修橋、趕造攻城器械，並在酷熱中維持馬匹的草料與飲水。決定遠征終止的時間點則明確：成吉思汗於八月二十五日卒於六盤山，死訊約在一二二一年秋末傳至印度河前線，此後原定的進取計劃取消，同一則消息亦令兩年後的迦勒迦河之役未能成行。
dataEn: This war left few figures behind and fewer reliable ones, but the outline can still be set out. In time, Multan fell to the Mongols early in 1221, and the action on the Sind followed within two or three months, most reckonings placing it in late spring or early summer; the April used here represents that range only, for the exact month cannot be established. In distance, the Mongol column moved from Multan down the right bank of the Indus to the line of Uch, a march of some three to four hundred kilometres through river bends, salt deltas and marsh. On strength, the accounts differ over the force that pushed deep into the Indus valley; the common order of magnitude is a few tens of thousands of horsemen, two to three myriads, with engineers, medical men and the camp servants besides. The Khwarazmians have no dependable figure: only the remnant cavalry and the garrisons of Multan and Uch can be seen, far below the pursuers. The cost of the march can be estimated as well: three to four months from Multan to the Sind, during which boats were requisitioned, bridges repaired, siege engines built, and fodder and water kept flowing to the horses in the heat. One date is firm: Genghis Khan died at Liupan on the twenty-fifth of August, and the news reached the Indus front about the end of the autumn of 1221, after which the planned advance was abandoned, and the same news called off the Kalka campaign planned for two years later.
cause: 申河之戰的起因是追擊。一二一九年起，成吉思汗以花剌子模殺死蒙古商隊為由發動第一次西征，四年之間破其國都、陷其名城，蘇丹札木亦兒一路西逃到高加索，又折回波斯，最後退到印度河下游的花剌子模故地。帝國的行政與軍隊都已瓦解，只剩一支由蘇丹直接指揮的騎兵殘部，以及克木蘭、烏奇等邊城。蒙古軍追到這裡有兩重理由：札木亦兒若在德里蘇丹國支持下重建勢力，等於在印度河東岸立起一個可以捲土重來的對手；克木蘭與下游商路又是這條戰線上財貨最集中的地方，攻下它們等於取得糧秣、牲畜與徵發的基地。因此追擊不停，雙方在印度河下游相遇：花剌子模軍要守住渡口與城池，蒙古軍要在洪水季之前把對手消滅在河西岸。這與同年更早的行動是同一條邏輯，蒙古西征從來不是一次決戰，而是一串把城市、渡口與倉庫逐個拿下的攻勢。對照卡面兵器：拜占庭帝國在十二世紀末面對的也是同一類問題，敵人用火船攻其城牆與艦隊，帝國卻只能靠一門祕方維持海上優勢，而祕方在保住城市之前就已經先失傳了。
causeEn: The cause of the Battle of the Sind was a pursuit. From 1219 Genghis Khan had set out on the first westward expedition on the ground that the Khwarazmians had killed a Mongol caravan. Within four years their capital had fallen and their cities had been taken; Sultan Jalal al-Din fled west to the Caucasus, doubled back into Persia and at last withdrew to the Khwarazmian lands on the lower Indus. The state's administration and army had been destroyed, leaving a remnant of cavalry under the sultan's own command and a handful of frontier towns such as Multan and Uch. The Mongols had two reasons for following: if Jalal al-Din rebuilt himself with the help of the Sultan of Delhi, a rival able to rise again would be established on the eastern bank of the Indus; and Multan and the trade routes below it held the densest concentrations of wealth on this line, so taking them meant grain, livestock and a base for requisitions. The pursuit therefore did not stop, and the two sides met on the lower Indus: the Khwarazmians needed to hold the fords and the towns, the Mongols needed to destroy the enemy west of the river before the flood season. The logic is the same as that of the earlier operations of the same year, for the Mongol expedition was never a single decisive battle but a succession of blows taken against cities, crossings and depots. Set the weapon on the card against it: the Byzantine Empire at the end of the twelfth century faced a problem of the same kind. Enemies came at its walls and its fleet with fire ships, and the empire could hold its maritime advantage only by way of one secret formula, which was lost before the city itself was saved.
impact: 這場戰役的結果決定了兩個政權的長久處境。對蒙古帝國來說，一二二一年的印度河是西征最遠的一道界線：蒙古軍在河西岸站住腳，沒有渡到德里的門前，此後北印度與蒙古的正面接觸要等六十多年後的邊境戰與十四世紀初的遠征才重新接上；克木蘭、烏奇一帶則在蒙古的經營下成為印度河下游的據點，供給後來西征與對西夏戰爭的馬匹與糧秣。對花剌子模而言，申河之後就再沒有國家了：蘇丹帶著最後的騎兵退入德里，帝國的疆域、名號與軍制在十年間散盡，蒙古與後來諸汗國都把這一段算作自己的西征功業。對北印度，德里蘇丹國因為收留札木亦兒而直接捲入蒙古的視線，一二二二年致書蒙古、一二二三年有蒙古使團抵達德里的記錄，是兩國最早的一批官方來往，這條線一直延到十三世紀末察合台系與德里蘇丹國的正面衝突。對兵器史而言，這一年也是個分水嶺：一二〇三年之後，能造出希臘火配方的國家已經沒有了，一二二一年尼西亞在伯羅奔尼撒打敗拉丁帝國的軍隊，靠的是普通拜占庭式戰艦與船上工程，而不是那門失傳的奇技；同一個冬天，蒙古軍在印度河上靠隨軍工匠與渡河器材拿下一座城。兩件事並排擺在一起，說明同一件事：能隨軍搬運的技術，壽命比靠祕方維持的技術長得多。
impactEn: The outcome of this battle settled the long condition of two states. For the Mongol Empire the Indus of 1221 was the furthest limit of the western expedition: the Mongols held the western bank and never came to the gates of Delhi, and direct contact between northern India and the Mongols had to wait more than sixty years, for the frontier wars and the expeditions of the early fourteenth century. Multan and the country around Uch, by contrast, were worked into a base on the lower Indus, supplying horses and provisions for the later campaigns in the west and for the war against the Western Xia. For Khwarazm, there was no state after the Sind: the sultan took his last cavalry into Delhi, and within ten years the territory, the name and the military system of the empire were gone, the Mongols and the later khans alike counting that stretch among the achievements of their western campaign. For northern India, the Delhi Sultanate was drawn straight into Mongol sight because it had given refuge to Jalal al-Din; the letter of 1222 and the Mongol embassy that reached Delhi in 1223 are the earliest official dealings between the two, a line that runs on to the open clashes between the Chagatai line and the Delhi Sultanate at the end of the thirteenth century. For the history of weapons the year is also a watershed. After 1203 there was no state left that could make the Greek fire formula, and the Nicaean victory over the Latin Empire in the Peloponnese in 1221 was won with ordinary Byzantine galleys and ordinary seamanship, not with the lost marvel. In the same winter the Mongols took a city on the Indus with a travelling corps of engineers and a bridge of hides and boats. Set the two side by side and one point stands out: technology that can be carried about lasts far longer than technology kept alive by a secret.
result: 點到為止：申河一役，蒙古軍在印度河下游擊破花剌子模殘部，攻下克木蘭與烏奇一線，把追擊的終點推到印度河西岸。役後雙方都沒有再爭這條河，花剌子模的蘇丹退往德里，帝國名號在傳統史書裡就此終結；蒙古軍在成吉思汗死訊傳到後放棄渡河計劃，收拾軍隊西撤，把西征的方向轉回波斯與高加索。可以確定的有三點。第一，蒙古第一次西征在印度河流域沒有取得永久性的政治成果，決定性的原因不是花剌子模的抵抗，而是季風洪水、酷熱與戰馬消耗三者的疊加，再加上大汗之死帶來的全面收縮。第二，這場戰役是蒙古攻城與渡河工程的一次壓力測試，配重投石車、壕溝地道、舟橋與牛皮浮囊在信德河邊全部用上，隨軍工匠營在幾個月內從無到有地把攻城能力做起來，說明蒙古西征的技術靠的是攜帶而不是佔領。第三，這場戰爭的記載確實有限，中文與波斯史料對交戰經過、日期與兵數的說法互有出入，能確定的只有大方向：蒙古追、花剌子模退、克木蘭與烏奇先後陷落、印度河未被渡過。卡面兵器希臘火在此役完全缺席，它與這場戰爭之間沒有任何可考的聯繫；能拿來對照的，只有它背後那套靠祕方維持的制度，與蒙古那套靠攜帶維持的制度之間的落差。
resultEn: To sum up: in the action on the Sind the Mongols broke the Khwarazmian remnant on the lower Indus, took Multan and the line of Uch, and pushed the end of the pursuit to the western bank of the river. Afterwards neither side fought for that river again. The Khwarazmian sultan withdrew to Delhi and the empire's name ends there in the traditional histories; on the news of Genghis's death the Mongols gave up the plan to cross, gathered their forces and withdrew west, turning the direction of the expedition back towards Persia and the Caucasus. Three things can be stated with certainty. First, the first westward expedition won no lasting political result in the Indus valley, and the deciding reasons were not the resistance of the Khwarazmians but the piling up of monsoon flood, scorching heat and the consumption of remounts, together with the general contraction that the death of the Great Khan forced on the campaign. Second, this battle was a stress test of the Mongol siege and river-crossing engineering: the counterweight trebuchet, the trench and mine, the pontoon bridge and the hide floats were all put to use on the banks of the Sind, and the travelling engineer corps built a siege capability from nothing within a few months, which shows that the technology of the western expedition rested on being carried rather than on being possessed. Third, the record of this war is indeed thin, and Chinese and Persian sources disagree over the course of the fighting, the dates and the numbers; only the broad direction can be relied on. The Mongols pursued, the Khwarazmians withdrew, Multan and then Uch fell, and the Indus was not crossed. The weapon on the card, Greek fire, was entirely absent from the field, and there is no traceable connection between it and this war; the only thing left to set against it is the difference between a system kept alive by a secret formula and a system kept alive by being carried from one river to the next.
